title: Sustainable Congo red (CR) and hexavalent chromium [Cr(VI)] removal using graphene functionalized aminated lignin composite: mechanistic and reusability insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14378-14394
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08641H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Md. Masum Billah, S. M. Fazle Rabbi, Md. Kamruzzaman, Mohammad Amirul Hoque, Riyadh Hossen Bhuiyan, Israt Jahan Nisa
A sustainable graphene–aminated lignin (MG–AL) composite achieves dual removal of Cr(VI) and Congo Red from wastewater via synergistic amine functionalization, defect-rich graphene, high chemisorption, and excellent reusability.
